title: Your Brain Is Lying to You

lines.text: Your brain can turn a small fear into a *giant* *monster.*
lines.style: Gripping narrator opening a viral short. Low, intimate and slightly ominous, brisk pace, lean hard into 'giant monster'.

lines.text: He has one sentence to say.

lines.style: Dropping lower and slower, building suspense.
Dramatic, heavy and intense, stretch the word 'enormous'.
Serious, sincere and empathetic, slow. Never dismissive.
Calm, slow and soothing, with natural pauses between each phrase.
A little more confident, counting an attempt.
Hopeful and rising, a turning point.

lines.text: And the shadow shrinks back to its real size.
Courage starts before you feel ready.
lines.style: Inspiring closing line. Warm, powerful and deliberate, each word lands.

music.title: Your Brain Is Lying to You
music.style: Cinematic emotional underscore for a motivational short film. Opens dark, intimate and suspenseful: low pulsing synth, deep drone, soft heartbeat-like kick, sparse piano notes. Tension builds through the middle. In the final third it resolves into a warm, hopeful, uplifting piano melody with soft strings swelling. Instrumental only, no vocals, gentle dynamics, mixed to sit under a voiceover.
